rule_title: TTP 1484.002 - DCShadow: SAM Domain Structure Access by DC Machine Account Without SAM_USER Events
description: Detects the DCShadow attack pattern: a burst of EID 4661 events accessing SAM_SERVER and SAM_DOMAIN objects attributed to the local DC machine account (SubjectUserSid S-1-5-18 / SYSTEM), without any accompanying SAM_USER events. Normal domain controller SAM operations by SYSTEM access domain structures transiently. DCShadow's lsadump::dcshadow uses these structures to inject forged replication data — the absence of SAM_USER events with the presence of SAM_DOMAIN bursts is the distinguishing characteristic versus lsadump::sam.
